description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/HelpCentre/GetTicket/{id}. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Reads one authenticated CRM support ticket by visible ticket id. Domain: support. Entity: support_ticket. Operation: get_exact. Scope: authenticated_user. Use when: Use when the user asks about an existing support ticket and provides the visible TCK-* ticket reference. Input: [FromRoute] id: string. Legacy numeric ids are not supported. Output: Returns ticket detail including visible id/number, state, priority, dates, customer and messages. Search terms: helpcentre getticket id.
name: hgr_get_helpcentre_getticket_id
title: Get Helpcentre Getticket ID
